Title: Strike: Combat ends + continue with the action

Messages.Author: Yomyael
Messages.Body:
I have two questions about this.

1.) If vampire A attempts an undirected action. Vampire A's controller's prey declines to block, then the predator blocks. Vampire A plays strike combat ends and continues with the action (e.g. form of mist). Gets vampire A's controller's prey another opportunity to block?

2.) If during the block an action modifier with the text "if this action is blocked" (e.g. skin of the chameleon) or a reaction card with "if this vampire successfully blocks this action" (e.g. spirit's touch) (assuming the same reacting vampire blocks again) was played. Do these cards have their effect still after the second block?

card text

Form of Mist
[Combat] Combat

[pro] Strike: dodge.
[PRO] Strike: combat ends. If this vampire is acting and needs stealth when this strike resolves, he or she may burn 1 blood after combat ends to continue the action at +1 stealth as if unblocked. A vampire may play only one Form of Mist at superior each action

Skin of the Chameleon

[1 Blood]

[tha] Only usable as an action is announced. If this action is blocked, this vampire gets an optional maneuver or press in the resulting combat.
[vis] +1 stealth. If this action is blocked, this acting vampire gets an optional maneuver or press in the resulting combat.
[VIS] As [vis] above, but with +2 stealth.

Spirit's Touch

[aus] +1 intercept.
[AUS] As above, with an optional maneuver in the resulting combat if this vampire successfully blocks this action.

Prince of Bonn, Germany

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Yomyael wrote:
> I have two questions about this.
>
> 1.) If vampire A attempts an undirected action. Vampire A's controller's prey declines to block, then the predator blocks. Vampire A plays strike combat ends and continues with the action (e.g. form of mist). Gets vampire A's controller's prey another opportunity to block?
>
No, since A declined to block.

> Yomyael wrote:
> 2.) If during the block an action modifier with the text "if this action is blocked" (e.g. skin of the chameleon) or a reaction card with "if this vampire successfully blocks this action" (e.g. spirit's touch) (assuming the same reacting vampire blocks again) was played. Do these cards have their effect still after the second block?
>
They do.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Timo
Messages.Body:
Normally, there would be a new block opportunity for every one (to be confirmed).

And the cards you give in example speak of "the resulting combat" without an s so every bonus an't kept for an other combat.
